panels.title: Power
panels.description: Power used from the grid now, all phases (1-0:1.7.0)

panels.title: Power per phase now
panels.description: Power per phase now. The scale is 5.75 kW, a 25 A fuse at 230 V

panels.title: Electricity today
panels.description: Electricity used since midnight, both tariffs

panels.title: Gas today
panels.description: Gas used since midnight. The meter reports the gas reading once an hour

panels.title: Outside
panels.description: Weather data: [Buienradar.nl](https://www.buienradar.nl)

panels.title: Power per phase
panels.description: Stacked, the top is the total power used. Power returned to the grid, from solar panels for example, shows below zero

panels.title: Current per phase
panels.description: Current per phase in whole amperes. The dashed line is a 25 A fuse

panels.title: Electricity per day
panels.description: Days run from midnight UTC, 01:00 or 02:00 Dutch time

panels.title: Gas per hour
panels.description: The meter reports the gas reading once an hour

panels.title: Gas per day and outside temperature
panels.description: Gas use against the average outside temperature of the day. Days run from midnight UTC. Weather data: [Buienradar.nl](https://www.buienradar.nl)

panels.title: Cost today
panels.description: Electricity and gas used since midnight, at the variable prices. Prices are the variables at the top of the dashboard

panels.title: Cost this month
panels.description: Electricity and gas used since the 1st, at the variable prices. Prices are the variables at the top of the dashboard

panels.title: Electricity this month
panels.description: Electricity used since the 1st of the month

panels.title: Gas this month
panels.description: Gas used since the 1st of the month

panels.title: Electricity, last 30 days
panels.description: Electricity used in the last 30 days and in the 30 days before

panels.title: Gas, last 30 days
panels.description: Gas used in the last 30 days and in the 30 days before

panels.title: Cost per day
panels.description: Electricity and gas per day at the variable prices, without fixed charges. Days run from midnight UTC. Prices are the variables at the top of the dashboard

panels.title: Base load and peak power per day
panels.description: Peak: the highest power of the day. Base load: the lowest 10-minute average of the day, the devices that are always on. Days run from midnight UTC

panels.title: Voltage sags per day
panels.description: Voltage sags counted by the meter per phase and day. Many sags on one phase point to a large load switching on, or a weak connection. Days run from midnight UTC

panels.title: Voltage sags
panels.description: Voltage sags per phase since the meter was installed

panels.title: Voltage swells
panels.description: Voltage swells per phase since the meter was installed

panels.title: Power failures
panels.description: Power failures in any phase since the meter was installed. A long failure lasts more than 3 minutes

panels.title: Voltage sags in range
panels.description: Voltage sags per phase in the selected time range

panels.title: Power failures in range
panels.description: Short and long power failures in the selected time range

panels.title: Outside temperature
panels.description: Weather data: [Buienradar.nl](https://www.buienradar.nl)

panels.title: Humidity and air pressure
panels.description: Weather data: [Buienradar.nl](https://www.buienradar.nl)

panels.title: Gas reading age
panels.description: Time since the gas meter took its last reading. It reports once an hour, an older reading means the gas meter is not reaching the electricity meter

panels.title: Returned reading tariff 1 (low)
panels.description: Electricity delivered back to the grid, from solar panels for example

panels.title: Returned reading tariff 2 (normal)
panels.description: Electricity delivered back to the grid, from solar panels for example

panels.title: Telegrams with CRC errors
panels.description: Telegrams discarded in the selected time range because their checksum did not match

panels.title: Last telegram
panels.description: Time since the last valid telegram from the meter. It sends one every 10 seconds
